About D'Iberville

Living in D'Iberville

D'Iberville sits on the north shore of the Back Bay of Biloxi and is named for the French explorer Pierre Le Moyne d'Iberville. It became a city in 1988 and has grown quickly around the Interstate 10 and Interstate 110 interchange.

Much of the housing is newer, with subdivisions north of the interstate and older homes along the bay. Shopping, restaurants and quick access to Biloxi make it a central spot on the Coast.

Getting around

Roads and commute

Interstate 10 and Interstate 110 meet here, and I-110 crosses the Back Bay straight into downtown Biloxi and the beach. Keesler Air Force Base is a few minutes south.

Workers who live in D'Iberville spend an average of 27 minutes getting to work, one way (Mississippi average: 25.6).

Near the water
